# Currency hedging management

Curated by Skill Harbor — @finsilabs's currency-hedging-management skill, listed here with credit to its creator (part of the awesome-ecommerce-skills series): a guide to managing currency-hedging for ecommerce operations. It covers FX exposure analysis (transaction and translation exposure across sales and payout currencies), hedging strategy selection (forwards, options, natural hedging via currency matching), hedge execution workflows, hedge accounting considerations, and hedge-effectiveness monitoring — with worked examples for cross-border sellers. Honest caveats: it is guidance, not financial advice and not a licensed treasury service — hedging decisions and their tax/accounting treatment belong to qualified finance professionals; market data (FX rates, forward curves) comes from your own data providers; executing hedges requires your own brokerage/bank relationships and is billed by them. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
